MESSAGE_NON_STEAM: This launcher is not supported; settings were not saved.
MESSAGE_INVALID_LAUNCH_OPTIONS: Launch options could not be edited safely.
CONTENT_CHECK_WINE_DESC: Try to apply for all launchers
CONTENT_GH_DESC: View usage guide or star this project on GitHub
NORMAL_SIDECAR_TOGGLE_DESC: Launch an additional Windows program alongside the primary program in the same Wine environment
ADVANCED_WINED3D_DESC: Use Wine's OpenGL renderer as a compatibility fallback instead of Proton's Vulkan translation layers
ADVANCED_STEAMDECK_DESKTOP_DESC: Report SteamDeck=0 so games use desktop behavior instead of Deck-specific presets
ADVANCED_NO_FSYNC_DESC: Disable futex-based synchronization as a compatibility fallback; this may reduce performance
ADVANCED_PULSE_LATENCY_DESC: Set PulseAudio compatibility latency to reduce crackling or dropouts; higher values increase audio delay
ADVANCED_STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH_DESC: Customize a path to save compatibility data for games, including saves
ADVANCED_LOSSLESS_SCALING_DESC: Enable LSFG-VK frame generation (requires Lossless-Scaling and decky-lsfg-vk plugin)
ADVANCED_DECKY_FRAMEGEN_PATCH_DESC: Disguise DLSS input to use FSR upscaling and frame generation (requires Decky-Framegen plugin)
ADVANCED_DECKY_FRAMEGEN_UNPATCH_DESC: Run once to uninstall the OptiScaler patch (requires Decky-Framegen plugin)
